LOCKDOCS_HEAD_WEIGHT.description: Override the heading share of the lexical score (default 0.25). Parsed as a floating-point number.

LOCKDOCS_DENSE_WEIGHT.description: Override the embedding share of reciprocal-rank fusion (default 0.1). Parsed as a floating-point number; non-positive values skip embeddings.

LOCKDOCS_DEBUG.description: Print ranking diagnostics to stderr when set to any valid Unicode value, including an empty string.

LOCKDOCS_UPSTREAM_BOOST.description: Override the score multiplier for prose from upstream docs (default 1.35). Parsed as a floating-point number.
